title: How a bubble forms
instruction: Put in order how one stop at a video turns into a feed about just one topic.
steps: You stop at a video with a puppy
The app records a long watch time
It offers more puppies to you and to people with similar taste
You watch them, because they happen to be in your feed
The feed is almost all puppies
debrief: A bubble forms from a loop: your signals → more of the same → more of the same signals. You can only break it with different signals.
why: It all starts with one signal.
For the recommender, watch time is the strongest signal.
It picks the next videos by the signal.
That sends more signals in the same direction.
The loop has closed: a bubble.
